summary: How lines of inline content sit inside their block.
details: It aligns the inline content (text, inline and inline-block children) within each line, not the block itself. start and end follow the writing direction, so they flip for right-to-left text.

values.note: Right in left-to-right text, e.g. numbers in a table.
Stretch lines to both edges (can leave gaps on narrow columns).

gotcha: text-align: center does not center a block element such as a fixed-width card; it only centers what is inside. Use margin-inline: auto, or flex/grid on the parent.
